race.comment: HE'S GODSPEED (10) just under two months between runs when he dropped in trip for a close-up on-speed fourth over 1370m in the Bowraville Cup. Strips fitter and maps to play a leading role. THE TORQUE XPRESS (7) blinkers and tongue-tie go on for this after he covered plenty of ground in the run with a wilting eleventh over 1400m at the Gold Coast. Goes well here and stays in the calculations. BARELLO (5) anchored with the 60.5kg in weaker grade with a close-up fifth over 1310m at Lismore. Senior rider hops aboard and can play a leading role. WANJINA ROSE (8) finally comes up with a good gate and assess on the good win three back at Coffs Harbour.
